function required<T>(value: T, name: string): NonNullable<T> {
  if (value == null) throw new Error(`${name} is missing`);
  return value;
}

function firstPresent<T>(values: T[]): NonNullable<T> | undefined {
  for (const value of values) {
    if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
      const present: NonNullable<T> = value;
      return present;
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function assumePresent<T>(value: T): NonNullable<T> {
  return value!;
}

function truthyOnly<T>(value: T): NonNullable<T> | "falsy" {
  if (value) {
    const kept: NonNullable<T> = value;
    return kept;
  }
  return "falsy";
}

console.log(required(3, "count"));
try {
  required<string | null>(null, "label");
} catch (error) {
  console.log((error as Error).message);
}
console.log(firstPresent([null, undefined, "b", "c"]));
console.log(firstPresent<number | null>([null]));
console.log(assumePresent("x"));
console.log(truthyOnly(0), truthyOnly("y"));
